comment: MSIX package identities used by build-msix.ps1. 'store' MUST be copied from Partner Center (Apps and games -> Socha Diff -> Product management -> Product identity): Package/Identity/Name, Package/Identity/Publisher and Package/Properties/PublisherDisplayName, character for character. Values containing PLACEHOLDER make the Store build refuse to run (the workflow then skips the .msixupload). 'sideload' is the local test identity: Publisher must equal the Subject of the signing certificate (the self-signed Socha3 cert, CN=Socha3), so the sideload .msix can be signed with the existing SIGNING_PFX_BASE64/SIGNING_PFX_PASSWORD secrets. Its Name differs from the Store one, so a sideloaded test build and the Store app install side by side.
